mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (student_id, password, name, gender, date_of_birth, ethnicity, native_place, political_status, phone_number, email, college, class_name, majors, enrollment_date, student_status, gpa, photo_url) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{dateOfBirth}, #{ethnicity}, #{nativePlace}, #{politicalStatus}, #{phoneNumber}, #{email}, #{college}, #{className}, #{major}, #{enrollmentDate}, #{studentStatus}, #{gpa}, #{photoUrl})
mapper.update: UPDATE students SET student_id = #{studentId}, password = #{password}, name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, date_of_birth = #{dateOfBirth}, ethnicity = #{ethnicity}, native_place = #{nativePlace}, political_status = #{politicalStatus}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, email = #{email}, college = #{college}, class_name = #{className}, majors = #{major}, enrollment_date = #{enrollmentDate}, student_status = #{studentStatus}, gpa = #{gpa}, photo_url = #{photoUrl} WHERE id = #{id}
